description: This file contains React hooks for managing OAuth clients and billing operations, including creating, updating, deleting OAuth clients, checking team billing status, subscribing teams to Stripe, and upgrading subscriptions.

methods.name: useCreateOAuthClient
methods.description: React hook for creating an OAuth client using a mutation.

methods.name: useUpdateOAuthClient
methods.description: React hook for updating an OAuth client with specified clientId.

methods.name: useDeleteOAuthClient
methods.description: React hook for deleting an OAuth client by id.

methods.name: useCheckTeamBilling
methods.description: React hook to check if a team has billing enabled.

methods.name: useSubscribeTeamToStripe
methods.description: React hook to subscribe a team to Stripe billing.

methods.name: useUpgradeTeamSubscriptionInStripe
methods.description: React hook to upgrade a team's subscription in Stripe.
